name: Festival Mreža
description: Ti si promoter koji vodi Kluboslavija turneju kroz 5 gradova. Makro: budžet, koordinatori, promo talasi. Mikro: real-time crowd routing 3-5 min po eventu. Carry-over buzz × 0.7. Cilj: Avala 20.jun sa satisfaction ≥ 90%.

modules.src/main.js: Entry point, game loop wire, layer switch (macro/micro/meta)
modules.src/config.js: Sve tuning konstante — BPM, budžet, decay, kapaciteti, seed primes
modules.src/state.js: macro/micro/meta state shape, localStorage save/load, migration
modules.src/input.js: Mouse/touch handlers za slider, redirect buttons, upgrade clicks
modules.src/render.js: Canvas render dispatcher — delegira na macro_renderer i micro_renderer
modules.src/ui.js: DOM UI updates, macro screen layout, event screens, AudioAPI emitters
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API implementacija — sve AudioAPI event handleri
modules.src/share.js: Share karta builder, html2canvas trigger, Web Share API, PNG download fallback
modules.src/systems/macro_engine.js: Makro round turn logic, decision processing, round end handler
modules.src/systems/micro_engine.js: Mikro event real-time loop, event_time_elapsed, event end trigger
modules.src/systems/crowd_spawner.js: Proceduralni crowd wave generisanje, LCG seed, carry-over guest injection
modules.src/systems/zone_manager.js: Zone state updates, overflow detection, onZoneOverflow emitter
modules.src/systems/routing_manager.js: Redirect button logic, migration speed, follow rate calculation
modules.src/systems/bpm_controller.js: BPM slider state, floor_temp calculation, Niš auto-arc, onBPMChange emitter
modules.src/systems/satisfaction_tracker.js: satisfaction_delta calculation, energy_debt update, peak phase detection
modules.src/systems/incident_manager.js: Incident creation, severity escalation, turn-based modal trigger
modules.src/systems/carry_over.js: Buzz carry-over formula, reputation calculation, guest crowd group creation
modules.src/systems/promo_engine.js: Promo decay simulation, buzz akumulacija po gradu, promo cost calculation
modules.src/systems/coordinator_manager.js: Hiring logic, loyalty updates, retention rolls, alumni management
modules.src/systems/upgrade_manager.js: Upgrade purchase validation, effect application, prereq checking
modules.src/systems/prestige_manager.js: Prestige reset logic, veteran insights selection, multiplier calculation
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Career tier check, achievement unlock, guncati/challenge unlock
modules.src/systems/performance_monitor.js: FPS tracking, particle_mode detection, hardware concurrency check
modules.src/entities/crowd_group.js: CrowdGroup class: mood update, energy decay, zone migration
modules.src/entities/zone.js: Zone class: capacity, current_crowd, overflow_active, mood_average
modules.src/entities/coordinator.js: Coordinator class: stats, loyalty tier calculation, unique ability apply
modules.src/entities/promo.js: PromoRecord class: decay calculation, current buzz value
modules.src/rendering/macro_renderer.js: Network graph Canvas render, city nodes, connection lines, buzz indicators
modules.src/rendering/micro_renderer.js: Venue top-down Canvas render, crowd particles, zone boundaries, floor_temp color
modules.src/rendering/hud_renderer.js: DOM HUD: satisfaction bar, energy debt bar, BPM indicator, floor temp
modules.src/rendering/incident_modal.js: Turn-based modal render, options display, choice handler
modules.src/content/aforizmi.js: Pera Period aforizmi: loading screen + share karta quotes (20 aforizama)
modules.src/content/coordinators_data.js: Coordinator static data (dialogs, base stats, unlock conditions)
modules.src/content/cities_data.js: City static data (venue tiers, wave configs, audio cityId mapping)
modules.styles/ui.css: Macro screen UI, cards, buttons, modal
modules.styles/game.css: Canvas animations, particle pulse, overflow glow, floor temp color transitions
